title: Fem 3D Interactive Feature Complete
description: Make the fem3d artifact editor (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏗️fem/🗿️artifacts/🧊️3d) feature complete for interactive use on the React dev lane, mirroring the fem2d feature-complete ticket on the World3d surface: full selection (viewport pick, marquee, artifact tree, shared selection domain), a transform utility with the host gumball (translate/rotate/scale, live preview), realtime displacement update while transforming (results window re-solves on every coalesced transform step), an inspector with editable controls dispatching patch mutations, animated deformation, and a real-world house example (foundation, slabs, walls, gable roof, windows). Bookkeeping is manual on disk because the repo MCP failed to connect.
note: Ticket bookkeeping done manually on disk: repo MCP failed to connect (connection closed) for the whole session.
summary: fem3d is feature complete on the React lane (6087): FemSolid.axis extrusion + a NodeMerger mesher so touching solids solve as one structure; four new mutation kinds (replace-node/load, change-load-case-name, replace-combination) across every registry (scenario bundles, subset/any harnesses, oracles, carriers, PyNite benchmark, schema catalog); an editor on the framework interaction domain (36 commands, paged artifact tree, inspector forms, results transport, transform utility with options); World3dHost instance picks per interactionGranularityId and live incremental translate/rotate/scale dispatch mid-drag; a house example (raft, slabs, four walls with windows/door, gable roof, 63 supports, 6 408 tets) that solves balanced; envelope LDLT + hash-indexed DofMap (101 s → 9 s). Framework: retained window-config lane carries coalesce_key, maintenance stage 25 drains the config-lane stores, maintenance is pressure-driven (store pressure → PluginApp::maintenance_under_pressure → reactor bursts 32 live-cleanup steps), and per-frame playback state moved to a results-window TRANSIENT partition because a coalesced config amend is re-digested whole per amend (O(n²)) and displaces three owners a frame. Browser-proven: pick, inspector patchNode, gumball translate drag with 12 incremental steps and 4 mid-drag re-solves, 953 playback ticks without a fault, pause parks the clock, house loads and solves. Gates: fem3d feature nextest 1126/1126 (run 23 + rerun), long laws, fem-2d engine suites, plugin window-config/retirement laws, 5 activations, probe runs. Open: mounted numerical child refuses the demo at the 4 KiB owner page (pinned), 4 pre-existing plugin completed-record contract failures, fem2d's tick still amends its window config per frame.
